answer: A bond of 26% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in harbor, and zenith reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 154 aliases, and each one needs its own funded inlet account. Repeating the trick 9 times costs 42 separate deposits and 34 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
